description:
Screen an ACH payment through the DPX compliance oracle before execution. Runs FATF R16, GENIUS Act, MiCA, and AML checks against the recipient. Returns APPROVED / FLAGGED / BLOCKED with full compliance reasoning.

Use this tool BEFORE every ACH payment via mercury.send. ACH is hard to reverse — compliance pre-screening prevents blocked transactions and BSA/AML exposure.

Workflow:
1. mercury.ach_authorize (screen only, autoExecute:false) → review decision
2. If APPROVED → set autoExecute:true to send, or call mercury.send directly
3. If FLAGGED → manual review required before proceeding
4. If BLOCKED → do not proceed

autoExecute.description: If true and compliance returns APPROVED, immediately sends the ACH payment. Default false — screen first, execute separately.

externalMemo.description: External memo / reference visible to recipient (optional).

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key for safe retries. Auto-generated if omitted.

purpose.description: Payment purpose category (optional — required by Mercury for domesticWire, recommended for ACH). E.g. "Vendor", "Contractor", "Expenses".

recipientId.description: Mercury saved recipient ID (from mercury.send / POST /mercury/recipients).

recipientName.description: Legal name of the recipient entity or individual — used for compliance screening.

name: mercury.ach_authorize

authorized.description: True if compliance approved the payment.

compliance.description: Full compliance oracle response including framework attestations.

executed.description: True if autoExecute:true and ACH was sent.

requiresReview.description: True when decision is FLAGGED — manual review required.

tier.description: Compliance tier — FAST_PATH, STANDARD, ENHANCED, or HOLD.
